joining_parts: OSR-FST-M8-FLOAT only for calculated secondary interfaces
method.release_gate: Controlled cut/flat-pattern pack, WPS/WPQR, qualified welders, weld map, NDT plan, dimensional survey and released structural proof.

steps.instruction: Verify drawing revision, heat certificates, section/plate identity, fixture calibration and datum targets before cutting. Quarantine substitutions.
steps.name: Release material and fixture

steps.instruction: Produce the controlled cut list and flat patterns; protect datum and bond lands; identify every primary part to heat and drawing position.
steps.name: Cut, form, machine and deburr

steps.instruction: Load parts against the 3-2-1 datum scheme, install calibrated shims/stops, tack to the released sequence and survey before production welding.
steps.name: Fixture, tack and survey

steps.instruction: Execute only the released weld map/WPS with heat-input and consumable records; use a balanced sequence and controlled cooling or stress relief where specified.
steps.name: Qualified weld and controlled cool

steps.instruction: Complete VT and classed MT/UT, repair through an NCR, machine released interfaces, survey the frame, restore edge/cavity protection and record coating batches.
steps.name: NDT, machine datums and coat

method.title: Locally fabricated steel body, bogie and interface structures
method.work_center: local steel preparation, weld and metrology cells

method.release_gate: Released laminate/core/insert map, fire evidence, material shelf life, mould survey, vacuum leak check, cure record, witness coupon, trim report, insert pull-out sample and master-frame dry fit.

steps.instruction: Inspect mould A-surface, split line, vacuum ports and datums; clean with the qualified system and apply the released semi-permanent release process. Record mould and release lots.
steps.name: Inspect, clean and release mould

steps.instruction: Apply the released UV/fire-compatible finish layer at controlled wet-film thickness. The supplier minimum/maximum overcoat window overrides this planning allowance.
steps.name: Apply exterior finish primer or gelcoat

steps.instruction: Place identified dry plies, local core and solid laminate lands to the released ply book; pot or fixture inserts and build a co-cured witness coupon.
steps.name: Load reinforcement, core, solid lands and inserts

steps.instruction: Install peel ply/flow media/bag and resin lines, record a stable vacuum leak test, then infuse within supplier temperature, viscosity and working-time limits.
steps.name: Bag, leak-test and infuse

steps.instruction: Hold the supplier-qualified time/temperature cure and record thermocouples. Do not demould on elapsed time alone; cure acceptance or hardness/Tg evidence controls release.
steps.name: Cure in mould

steps.instruction: Demould without prying on show surfaces; inspect/tap-check, CNC trim and drill in the datum fixture, seal every cut edge, install inserts/seals, gauge the part and dry-fit it to the master frame.
steps.name: Demould, trim, seal and dry-fit

method.title: Reusable GFRP body, roof, end-cowl and interior panel mould families
method.work_center: local composite moulding, cure, trim and dry-fit cell

joining_parts: in-mould white gelcoat or qualified base topcoat
rail-application livery film and edge treatment
method.release_gate: Base corrosion/fire protection accepted first; then film substrate/adhesion/edge/removal evidence and radiative-coating fire, adhesion, weathering, cleanability, glare and measured new/aged solar reflectance/emittance. No cooling or energy-saving claim before one-car thermal and maintenance trials.

steps.instruction: Verify cured laminate, sealed edges, moisture/temperature limits and defect repair; mask bonds, seals, datums, windows, sensors and electrical earths.
steps.name: Condition and inspect substrate

steps.instruction: Accept the fully cured corrosion/gelcoat base, make adhesion coupons, and plot/cut the livery film from controlled bay templates. Do not apply film over seals, drains, earths, labels, service lands or unresolved defects.
steps.name: Prepare base finish and cut film

steps.instruction: Dry-apply and squeegee the selected rail-use film with controlled seams/edges. On qualified exposed-roof zones only, mask all keep-outs and apply the CaCO3 candidate beside retained witness coupons to the released wet/dry-film range.
steps.name: Apply livery film and candidate roof coating

steps.instruction: Maintain the film/coating suppliers' temperature, humidity and ventilation limits; post-heat or edge-treat film only where the selected system requires it, and let the roof coating reach its released cure before handling.
steps.name: Controlled cure

steps.instruction: Inspect bubbles, wrinkles, seams, edges and prohibited-zone masking; record coating thickness/adhesion/cure, colour/gloss and measured solar reflectance/emittance, and retain labelled coupons for UV, abrasion and wash ageing.
steps.name: Inspect and retain coupons

method.title: In-mould base finish, applied livery film, and qualified radiative roof-coating route
method.work_center: local surface preparation, film application and controlled coating cell

method.release_gate: Supplier glazing/edge certificate, retained frame calculation, approved surface preparation, seal compression map, drain test, water-ingress test, heater/isolation test where fitted and timed replacement demonstration.

steps.instruction: Confirm pane/cassette identity and orientation; inspect laminate, edges, frame bond and heater terminals. Quarantine any edge impact, delamination or expired adhesive evidence.
steps.name: Receive and inspect cassette

steps.instruction: Gauge carrier-ring datums and drains, protect glass edges, place the cassette on nonmetallic setting blocks and confirm uniform design clearance without forcing the glass.
steps.name: Gauge aperture and dry-fit

steps.instruction: Fit the one-piece keyed seal without stretch, lubricants or unapproved sealant; install the pressure frame and tighten captive fasteners in the released cross-pattern to the joint schedule.
steps.name: Install dry seal and pressure frame

steps.instruction: Measure seal compression at the released witness points; confirm drain continuity, secondary retention, electrical isolation and heater continuity where fitted.
steps.name: Verify compression, drains and services

steps.instruction: Run the controlled spray test, inspect the dry side and drains, then remove/refit the first article with the documented lifting/jacking method and record elapsed replacement time.
steps.name: Water and replacement test

method.title: Replaceable side-window cassette, pressure frame, seal and drain installation
method.work_center: local glazing preparation and vehicle fit-out cell

method.release_gate: Supplier and interface freeze, carrier load proof, EN 14752/national evidence as applicable, datum and seal maps, closed-and-locked loop, obstacle detection, emergency release, water test and timed cassette replacement.

steps.instruction: Verify serial/revision/evidence, inspect seals/leaf/drive and gauge the locally made portal and four carrier datums before lifting the cassette.
steps.name: Accept supplier cassette and portal

steps.instruction: Use the approved lift points; engage datum pins, install four carrier shoes and adjust only within their released range to achieve leaf/aperture geometry without distorting the cassette.
steps.name: Lift, pin and adjust carrier

steps.instruction: Install sealed fasteners to the controlled joint schedule, fit the keyed replaceable seal and connector, retain service loops and record final adjuster positions and witness marks.
steps.name: Join, seal and connect

steps.instruction: Test open/close cycles, obstruction detection, closed-and-locked circuit, traction interlock, emergency release, local isolation and degraded/manual operation under the supplier procedure.
steps.name: Static functional and safety tests

steps.instruction: Run the controlled water test and first-article removal/refit; repeat safety tests after replacement and record time, tooling and adjustments.
steps.name: Ingress and replacement demonstration

method.title: Supplier door cassette on locally made four-point adjustable carrier
method.work_center: local door preparation, installation and static-test cell

method.release_gate: Fire/smoke certificates, substrate moisture/flatness, adhesive batch and open time, seam/edge detail, slip resistance, hatch removal, fixture load calculations and proof samples, PRM/egress gauge and snag/rattle inspection.

steps.instruction: Gauge floor supports, dry-fit numbered boards/hatches, verify flush joints, edge radii, lift points and uninterrupted access to battery/HV inspection zones.
steps.name: Dry-build removable floor and service hatches

steps.instruction: Verify substrate flatness, dryness and cleanliness; cut labelled floor pieces from controlled CAD templates and preserve access-hatch breaks, coved edges and drainage paths.
steps.name: Prepare floor and pre-cut covering

steps.instruction: Condition material, apply only the selected supplier adhesive at specified spread rate/open time, lay without trapped air, roll in both directions and complete released seam/edge treatment.
steps.name: Bond covering

steps.instruction: Set blind threaded inserts perpendicular with the supplier force-controlled tool and sampled pull checks; gauge OSR-RAIL-42 pitch/alignment and preserve galvanic isolation.
steps.name: Install service rails and inserts

steps.instruction: Install seats, handrails and equipment through released saddles/joints; record torque/locking, then proof-load first articles to the approved fixture calculation without using trim as a load path.
steps.name: Mount and proof passenger fixtures

steps.instruction: Respect adhesive return-to-service time, inspect adhesion/seams/slip and PRM geometry, remove/refit every service hatch and complete snag, sharp-edge and rattle checks.
steps.name: Finish, cure and inspect

method.title: Removable floor panels, transport flooring and common passenger-fixture rail
method.work_center: local interior panel, floor and fixture preassembly cell

joining_parts: supplier motor and gearbox mounting kit
method.release_gate: Supplier motor/gearbox/wheelset/brake freeze, bogie-frame proof/NDT, mount-load proof, certified fastener/joint schedule, alignment and backlash, lubrication, insulation/bonding, rotation, brake and thermal instrumentation tests.

steps.instruction: Verify bogie frame NDT/datum survey and all serialized motor, gearbox, coupling, wheelset, bearing, brake and suspension evidence before unpacking.
steps.name: Accept frame and supplier kits

steps.instruction: Load the controlled bogie stand, install axlebox/suspension/brake kits under supplier instructions and record orientation, clearances, lubrication and safety locking.
steps.name: Set wheelsets and running gear

steps.instruction: Use the dedicated alignment fixture; lift from supplier points, set mount shims, coupling/gear mesh and torque link, then close released high-integrity joints with calibrated tools and independent witness.
steps.name: Install and align motor/gearbox

steps.instruction: Install bonding, temperature/speed/WSP harnesses, junctions, guards and safety lanyards with released bend radii, movement envelope and service access.
steps.name: Route services and guards

steps.instruction: Check free rotation, alignment/backlash, oil level/leaks, brake application/release, insulation resistance, bonding and sensor polarity before powered testing.
steps.name: Static rotation, brake and electrical tests

steps.instruction: Record mass/ride-height setup, close inspection covers, apply witness marks and preservation, and quarantine the bogie until vehicle marriage.
steps.name: Release and preserve

method.title: Supplier traction motor/gearbox integration into locally fabricated powered bogie
method.work_center: local bogie build, alignment and static-test cell

method.release_gate: Supplier evidence, fire/EMC/vibration/IP checks, harness 100% continuity and insulation, keyed/polarity audit, HVIL, fluid pressure/drain tests, lighting lux/emergency-duration test, HVAC airflow and condensate test.

steps.instruction: Build lighting, harness, duct, tray and cabinet modules on dedicated boards/rails; record serials, connectors, firmware/configuration and incoming evidence.
steps.name: Preassemble and test modules off vehicle

steps.instruction: Gauge common datums, install isolated rails/trays and supplier-approved seals, protect fire barriers and preserve removable access zones.
steps.name: Install rails, trays, ducts and curb seals

steps.instruction: Route pre-terminated looms to released clips and bend radii; keep HV, LV/data and fluids segregated, fit service loops and blanking caps, and prevent field-cut lighting wires.
steps.name: Install keyed LV/data and segregated HV services

steps.instruction: Use approved lifts and supplier mounting kits; close coolant, drain, bond, service-disconnect and HVIL interfaces under LOTO.
steps.name: Install HVAC, batteries and power modules

steps.instruction: Complete continuity, insulation, bonding, connector keying, sensor enumeration, pressure/leak and drain-flow tests before energisation.
steps.name: Cold commissioning

steps.instruction: Run lighting lux/emergency tests, HVAC airflow/condensate tests and controlled HVIL/pre-charge checks; attach actual records to the train configuration.
steps.name: Functional release

method.title: Lighting, HVAC, HV/LV services and keyed replaceable modules
method.work_center: local harness, interior systems and roof-module preassembly cells

method.release_gate: All child travelers accepted, train mass/geometry/clearance, brake/door/HV/communications/fire-detection tests, software/configuration hashes, static and low-speed test evidence, open NCR review and independent manufacturing release.

steps.instruction: Verify signed child travelers, serial/configuration records, lifting-column certification, track level and vehicle datum survey; unresolved safety NCRs block marriage.
steps.name: Accept child assemblies and final road

steps.instruction: Lift only at released points, roll accepted bogies into surveyed positions, lower onto interfaces, close body/bogie and articulation joints, and independently witness safety-critical locking.
steps.name: Bogie marriage and articulation

steps.instruction: Connect labelled HV/LV/data/coolant/air paths, install end equipment and remaining service panels, then perform continuity, leak, movement-envelope and access checks.
steps.name: Close trainlines, couplers and remaining fit-out

steps.instruction: Run brake, door/interlock, lighting, HVAC, battery/HVIL, detection, communications, passenger systems, emergency and degraded-mode procedures against released test scripts.
steps.name: Static systems commissioning

steps.instruction: Survey ride height/body/articulation/clearance, weigh the train, run roof/door/window ingress tests and reconcile the as-built mass and configuration records.
steps.name: Geometry, mass and water tests

steps.instruction: Review all records and NCRs, freeze software/configuration hashes and issue only a manufacturing release to the authorised low-speed/static test programme—not passenger service approval.
steps.name: Independent review and controlled release

method.title: Three-car final assembly, static test and manufacturing release
method.work_center: 55 m local final assembly and static-test road

planning_basis: Pilot local-manufacture route for one LM3 three-car trainset; elapsed allowances support factory planning but never override a released material datasheet, supplier manual, WPS, adhesive open/cure time, or competent engineering decision.
release_boundary: Not a construction release. Supplier freeze, controlled drawings, structural calculations, fire/rail evidence, qualified special processes, first-article tests, independent safety assessment, and national authorisation remain mandatory.

source.use: Surface preparation, controlled bead geometry, glazing, floor/interior bonding and exterior sealing process categories; the selected adhesive technical datasheet controls primers, open time, cure and safe handling.

source.use: Research basis for the CaCO3-acrylic candidate and initial optical targets. It is not rail qualification, a commercial product release, or evidence of durability on moving-vehicle GFRP.
